notes.text: Patrick Kane is out (upper-body injury), reported after he played in their last game. He is a top-six forward.

Bowen Byram is on injured reserve and has missed the last 8 games. He is a top-pair defenseman. Wyatt Kaiser has taken his spot beside Artyom Levshunov. That pair has had 33% of the chances at 5-on-5 in 91:57 together, down from 47% with Byram.
Aleksander Barkov is on long-term injured reserve (knee injury) and has missed the last 13 games. He is one of their best players.
Brad Marchand is on injured reserve (knee injury) and has missed the last 11 games. He is a top-six forward.

Uvis Balinskis has not dressed for the last 4 games. Radko Gudas has taken his spot beside Dmitry Kulikov. That pair has had 37% of the chances at 5-on-5 in 45:53 together, up from 32% with Balinskis.
Cole Reinhardt was added to the roster on Oct 23 and has played beside Eetu Luostarinen and Anton Lundell.

stakes: The Blackhawks go in eighth in the Central with 9 points, the Panthers tied for fifth in the Atlantic with 18 points.

FLA.head: This one sets up well for the Panthers
FLA.body: Even though Florida will be without Barkov, the Panthers have been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately and have home-ice advantage. The Blackhawks’ best way in is keeping dangerous shots away.

CHI.head: The Panthers should be favored
CHI.body: Even though Florida will be without Barkov, the Panthers have been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately and have home-ice advantage. To pull this off, the Blackhawks can start with keeping dangerous shots away, plus Spencer Knight stealing the show.

story.head: Who drives the play: the Panthers
paras: The Panthers won the teams’ first meeting this season, 3-2 in Chicago on Oct 25. The Panthers (8-5-2) lost 5-3 to Detroit on Monday, and the Blackhawks are winless in three (0-2-1). Going in, the Hawks are last in the Central (31st in the NHL) and the Panthers fifth in the Atlantic (tied for 13th).

The Blackhawks haven’t played well, but their record (.300) is worse than their play: their chances are worth about .384, and their finishing has held them back. The Panthers’ record (.600) is about what their chances are worth.

The Blackhawks do a lot of their shooting from distance (2nd lowest), don't block many shots (32nd) and have struggled on the power play (32nd). Chicago has scored 2.20 goals a game, the second fewest in the league, and allowed 3.87, the second most. The Panthers forecheck harder than anyone (1st) and rarely ice the puck (1st). They also are the league’s most physical team (1st), so the Panthers hit a lot, but the Blackhawks mostly don’t. The Panthers are likely to get plenty of pucks to the net against the Blackhawks.

Connor Bedard (4 G / 6 A / 10 P in 9 GP) leads the Blackhawks in scoring, and Roman Kantserov (6 G / 2 A / 8 P in 15 GP) has a team-high six goals. Matthew Tkachuk (4 G / 17 A / 21 P in 15 GP) leads the Panthers in scoring and is tied for tenth in the NHL, and Brady Tkachuk (8 G / 8 A / 16 P in 15 GP) has a team-high eight goals.
Spencer Knight (4-8-0 / .894 SV% in 12 GS) is expected to start for Chicago, and Jacob Markström (3-2-1 / .890 SV% in 7 GS) for Florida.
The Panthers usually control more of the chances than the Blackhawks do.
